description_short: Complex cross-table query that groups isotropic SiO2 ALE processes from Tables V and VI by mechanism class, aggregating etch rates, rate-limiting temperatures, and plasma requirements.

paper.title: Atomic Layer Etching of SiO2 for Nanoscale Semiconductor Devices: A Review

tables_modeled.label: Table V
tables_modeled.description: Thermal isotropic SiO2 ALE processes, including AFS-based and related chemistries.

tables_modeled.label: Table VI
tables_modeled.description: Plasma-assisted isotropic SiO2 ALE processes, including AFS-based plasma-assisted chemistries.

properties_used.label: Etching mechanism
properties_used.role: High-level description of the isotropic SiO2 ALE mechanism; used to infer mechanism classes such as Al2O3-conversion cycles and AFS-based processes.

properties_used.label: Step 1 description
properties_used.role: Textual description of the first ALE step; contributes to detecting plasma usage and parsing rate-limiting temperatures.

properties_used.label: Step 2 description
properties_used.role: Textual description of the second ALE step; contributes to detecting plasma usage and parsing rate-limiting temperatures.

properties_used.label: Step 3 description
properties_used.role: Textual description of the third ALE step; contributes to detecting plasma usage and parsing rate-limiting temperatures.

properties_used.label: Etching rate (EPC)
properties_used.role: Etch-per-cycle (Å/cycle) for each isotropic SiO2 ALE process; parsed to numeric form and used to compute min, max, and mean EPC per mechanism class.

aggregation.description: Mechanism classes are inferred from the etching mechanism label and step descriptions: 'Al2O3-conversion cycles' when the mechanism mentions Al2O3; 'AFS-based thermal' when the mechanism mentions (NH4)2SiF6 without plasma in the steps; 'AFS-based plasma-assisted' when (NH4)2SiF6 and plasma both appear; and 'Other' for all remaining cases.

output_shape.description: One row per inferred etching mechanism class summarizing process counts, etch-rate statistics, rate-limiting temperatures, and plasma dependence.
columns: etching_mechanism_class: inferred mechanism class label (e.g. 'Al2O3-conversion cycles', 'AFS-based thermal', 'AFS-based plasma-assisted', 'Other').
n_variants: number of distinct isotropic SiO2 ALE process variants assigned to the class.
min_etch_rate: minimum etch-per-cycle rate (Å/cycle) observed in the class.
max_etch_rate: maximum etch-per-cycle rate (Å/cycle) observed in the class.
mean_etch_rate: mean etch-per-cycle rate (Å/cycle) across all class members.
min_temp_rate_lim: minimum inferred rate-limiting temperature (°C) across all steps in the class.
max_temp_rate_lim: maximum inferred rate-limiting temperature (°C) across all steps in the class.
plasma_required: 'yes' if any process in the class uses plasma in any step; 'no' otherwise.
high_rate_low_temp: 'yes' if the class includes at least one variant with EPC > 5 Å/cycle and a rate-limiting temperature < 200 °C; 'no' otherwise.

postprocessing_notes.interpretation: The query compares thermal vs. plasma-assisted isotropic SiO2 ALE at the mechanism-class level, showing which chemistries achieve high etch rates at low temperatures and whether those regimes intrinsically require plasma. This supports data-driven selection of isotropic ALE strategies for temperature-sensitive device integration.
